privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This private, non-commercial family website lets you browse the family tree. It is run by an individual, its administrator.

collected.title: Data we collect
collected.body: You can browse the site without an account. If you sign in with {{providers}}, we receive and keep only: the technical identifier of your account with that provider, your name, your email address and your profile picture, as well as the account creation and last sign-in dates. No password is ever sent or stored.

purpose.title: How we use it
purpose.body: This data is only used to identify you and manage your access rights to the tree. It is never sold, shared or used for advertising.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.body: The site uses a single, strictly necessary cookie to keep you signed in, and a temporary cookie during sign-in. Your language choice is stored in your browser. No advertising cookies or analytics tools are used.

genealogy.title: Genealogical data
genealogy.body: The tree contains information about family members (names, dates, places, occupations). For people born less than 100 years ago, only the name is publicly visible; details are only available to members authorized by the administrator. Anyone listed in the tree may ask for their information to be corrected or removed.
genealogy.bodyHidden: The tree contains information about family members (names, dates, places, occupations). People born less than 100 years ago only appear anonymously to the public, with no name or any other information; details are only available to members authorized by the administrator. Anyone listed in the tree may ask for their information to be corrected or removed.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: Your account data is kept as long as your account exists. It is deleted as soon as you or the administrator delete your account.

deletion.title: Deleting your data
deletion.body: You can delete your account and all associated data yourself at any time: sign in, open the “Account and preferences” page and click “Delete my account”. Deletion is immediate. You can also remove the site’s access from your {{providers}} account settings, or ask the administrator to delete your data.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under the GDPR, you have the right to access, correct, erase and object to the processing of your data. You may also lodge a complaint with the French data protection authority, the CNIL (www.cnil.fr).

contact.title: Contact
contact.none: For any question or request, contact the site administrator.

terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: This free, non-commercial family website lets you browse the family tree. By using it, you accept the following terms.

access.title: Access
access.body: Browsing is open to everyone. Sign-in uses a {{providers}} account; the administrator decides which rights each account gets and may suspend or delete an account at any time.

content.title: Content
content.body: The information comes from family research and may contain errors or gaps. It is intended for personal and family use: commercial reuse, or publishing information about living people, is forbidden.

liability.title: Liability
liability.body: The site is provided “as is”, with no guarantee of availability or accuracy. It may be changed or discontinued at any time.

source.title: Software
